title: HackerRank SQL
description: Полный раздел SQL Domain на HackerRank: шесть подразделов (Basic Select, Advanced Select, Aggregation, Basic Join, Advanced Join, Alternative Queries), 58 sqlite-задач с русскими условиями, ссылками на оригинал и автопроверкой в браузере (SQLite 3 / sql.js).

steps.title: HackerRank и SQLite в приложении
steps.content:
## Курс HackerRank SQL

Задачи с [SQL Domain](https://www.hackerrank.com/domains/sql) адаптированы под **SQLite 3** (sql.js). На HackerRank часто MySQL/Oracle; здесь — диалект SQLite.

### Строки и числа

| HackerRank (MySQL) | SQLite |
|--------------------|--------|
| `CONCAT(a, b)` | `a \|\| b` или `printf` |
| `LENGTH(s)` | `LENGTH(s)` |
| `SUBSTR(s, pos, len)` | `SUBSTR(s, pos, len)` (позиция с 1) |
| `ROUND(x, d)` | `ROUND(x, d)` |
| `CEIL(x)` / `CEILING(x)` | `CEIL(x)` / `CEILING(x)` (зарегистрированы в приложении) |

### REGEXP и генерация строк

- **`REGEXP`** в приложении — семантика **JavaScript** `RegExp` (регистрозависимый).
- Задачи «нарисовать треугольник» / «простые числа»: параметр **`N`** в таблице **`params(n)`** через `seed`; строки генерируют **`WITH RECURSIVE`**.

### Проверка

- Сравнивается **последний** result set.
- **`orderMatters: true`** — когда важен порядок строк (форматированный вывод, сортировка по условию).
- **`checkColumnNames: true`** — имена колонок как в эталоне.

В каждой задаче — ссылка на оригинал HackerRank.

content.caption: На каждый тест: **setup → seed → ваш SQL**
content.description: Данные не переносятся между seed-тестами.

steps.title: SELECT, WHERE, DISTINCT
steps.content:
## Basic Select

- **`SELECT`**, **`WHERE`**, **`ORDER BY`**, **`DISTINCT`**, **`LIMIT`**.
- HackerRank часто использует таблицы `CITY`, `STATION`, `STUDENTS`.
- Для гласных в `STATION` — **`REGEXP`** (JS RegExp в приложении): `^` / `$`, классы `[AEIOUaeiou]`.

content.caption: WHERE отсеивает строки до проекции
content.description: Чётность `ID` — `ID % 2 = 0` в SQLite.
content.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 280 80" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Basic Select"><rect id="hr01-box" x="40" y="15" width="200" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e3f2fd" stroke="#1565c0"/><text x="140" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#0d47a1">Basic Select</text></svg>

content.description:
Выведите **все** поля из `CITY`, где `COUNTRYCODE = 'USA'` и `POPULATION > 100000`.

[HackerRank: Revising the Select Query](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-the-select-query/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'USA' OR POPULATION > 100000;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'USA' AND POPULATION > 100000;

content.description:
Верните `NAME` и `COUNTRYCODE` для городов с `POPULATION > 120000` и `COUNTRYCODE = 'USA'`. Сортировка по `NAME`.

[HackerRank: Revising the Select Query II](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-the-select-query-ii/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME, COUNTRYCODE FROM CITY WHERE POPULATION > 120000 AND COUNTRYCODE = 'USA' ORDER BY NAME DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT NAME, COUNTRYCODE FROM CITY WHERE POPULATION > 120000 AND COUNTRYCODE = 'USA' ORDER BY NAME;

content.description:
Выведите **все** столбцы и **все** строки таблицы `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Select All](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/select-all-sql/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME FROM CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM CITY;

content.description:
Выведите все поля города с `ID = 1661`.

[HackerRank: Select by ID](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/select-by-id/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE ID = 1660;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE ID = 1661;

content.description:
Все атрибуты городов с `COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`.

[HackerRank: Japanese Cities' Attributes](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/japanese-cities-attributes/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN' OR COUNTRYCODE = 'CHN';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN';

content.description:
Только `NAME` городов Японии (`COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`).

[HackerRank: Japanese Cities' Names](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/japanese-cities-names/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME, COUNTRYCODE FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT NAME FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN';

content.description:
Для записей с **чётным** `ID` верните `CITY` и `LONG_W` (как longitude). Сортировка по `ID`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 1](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-1/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE ID % 2 = 1 ORDER BY ID;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE ID % 2 = 0 ORDER BY ID;

content.description:
**Различные** `CITY` для станций с чётным `ID`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 3](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-3/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE ID % 2 = 0;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT CITY FROM STATION WHERE ID % 2 = 0;

content.description:
Сколько городов (`CITY`) **начинаются с гласной** (A, E, I, O, U)?

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 4](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-4/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STATION WHERE CITY REGEXP '^[BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ]';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT COUNT(CITY) FROM STATION WHERE CITY REGEXP '^[AEIOUaeiou]';

content.description:
Среди **северных** станций (`LAT_N > 0`) найдите город, **не** начинающийся с гласной, с **минимальным** именем по алфавиту. Одна строка `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 5](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-5/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0 AND CITY REGEXP '^[AEIOUaeiou]' ORDER BY CITY LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0 AND CITY NOT REGEXP '^[AEIOUaeiou]' ORDER BY CITY LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Города, **не** начинающиеся с гласной. Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 6](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-6/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE CITY REGEXP '^[AEIOUaeiou]' ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE CITY NOT REGEXP '^[AEIOUaeiou]' ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
**Различные** города, **заканчивающиеся** на гласную. Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 7](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-7/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE CITY REGEXP '[AEIOUaeiou]$' ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT CITY FROM STATION WHERE CITY REGEXP '[AEIOUaeiou]$' ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
Города с **северной** широтой (`LAT_N > 0`) и **восточной** долготой (`LONG_W > 0`). Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 8](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-8/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0 OR LONG_W > 0 ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0 AND LONG_W > 0 ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
Города с `LAT_N < 0` и `LONG_W > 0`. Верните `CITY`, `LAT_N` и `LONG_W`, округлённые до **2** знаков. Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 9](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-9/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY, LAT_N, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N < 0 OR LONG_W > 0 ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY, ROUND(LAT_N, 2), ROUND(LONG_W, 2) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N < 0 AND LONG_W > 0 ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
Города **не** на экваторе (`LAT_N <> 0`). Сортировка: `LAT_N` по убыванию, затем `CITY` по возрастанию.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 10](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-10/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0 ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N <> 0 ORDER BY LAT_N DESC, CITY ASC;

content.description:
**Различные** `CITY` не на экваторе. Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 11](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-11/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N <> 0 ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N <> 0 ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
Для каждой станции верните `CITY`, `LAT_N` и `LONG_W`, округлённые до **2** десятичных знаков. Сортировка по `ID`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 12](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-12/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY, LAT_N, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE ID < 0 ORDER BY ID;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY, ROUND(LAT_N, 2), ROUND(LONG_W, 2) FROM STATION ORDER BY ID;

content.description:

Имена и зарплаты с `Salary > 2000`. Сортировка по `Salary`.

[HackerRank: Employee Salaries](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/employee-salaries/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT NOT NULL, Salary INTEGER NOT NULL);

steps.title: CASE, строки, pivot
steps.content:
## Advanced Select

- **`CASE`** для классификации (треугольники, типы узлов).
- Форматирование строк: `SUBSTR`, `||`, `printf`, «псевдо-LPAD/RPAD».
- Pivot через `ROW_NUMBER()` + `MIN(CASE WHEN …)` (Occupations).

content.caption: CASE возвращает метку по условию
content.description: Pivot выравнивает строки по rn внутри профессий.
content.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 280 80" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Advanced Select"><rect id="hr02-box" x="40" y="15" width="200" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e3f2fd" stroke="#1565c0"/><text x="140" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#0d47a1">Advanced Select</text></svg>

content.description:
Для каждой строки `TRIANGLES` верните тип: `Equilateral`, `Isosceles`, `Scalene` или `Not A Triangle`. Сортировка по `triangle_type`.

[HackerRank: The Type of Triangle](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/what-type-of-triangle/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE TRIANGLES(A INTEGER NOT NULL, B INTEGER NOT NULL, C INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CASE WHEN A = B AND B = C THEN 'Equilateral' ELSE 'Scalene' END AS triangle_type FROM TRIANGLES ORDER BY triangle_type;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN A + B <= C OR A + C <= B OR B + C <= A THEN 'Not A Triangle'
  WHEN A = B AND B = C THEN 'Equilateral'
  WHEN A = B OR B = C OR A = C THEN 'Isosceles'
  ELSE 'Scalene'
END AS triangle_type
FROM TRIANGLES
ORDER BY triangle_type;

content.description:
Для каждого `Name` в `Customers`: слева дополните `-` до ширины `2*LENGTH(Name)-1`, справа дополните `|` до той же ширины; склеить. Сортировка по `Name`.

[HackerRank: The PADS](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/the-pads/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Customers(Name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT Name FROM Customers ORDER BY Name;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT
  SUBSTR('----------', 1, LENGTH(Name) - 1) || Name ||
  SUBSTR(Name || '||||||||||', 1, 2 * LENGTH(Name) - 1)
FROM Customers
ORDER BY Name;

content.description:
Разверните `OCCUPATIONS` в четыре колонки: `Doctor`, `Professor`, `Singer`, `Actor` — имена в алфавитном порядке по профессиям, строки выровнены по порядковому номеру внутри профессии.

[HackerRank: Occupations](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/occupations/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE OCCUPATIONS(Occupation TEXT NOT NULL, Name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT Occupation, Name FROM OCCUPATIONS ORDER BY Occupation, Name;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT
  MIN(CASE WHEN Occupation = 'Doctor' THEN Name END) AS Doctor,
  MIN(CASE WHEN Occupation = 'Professor' THEN Name END) AS Professor,
  MIN(CASE WHEN Occupation = 'Singer' THEN Name END) AS Singer,
  MIN(CASE WHEN Occupation = 'Actor' THEN Name END) AS Actor
FROM (
  SELECT Occupation, Name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Occupation ORDER BY Name) AS rn
  FROM OCCUPATIONS
) t
GROUP BY rn
ORDER BY rn;

content.description:
Для каждого узла `BTree` (`N`, родитель `P`) верните колонки **`N`**, **`Type`**: `Root`, `Inner` или `Leaf`. Сортировка по `N`.

[HackerRank: Binary Tree Nodes](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/binary-tree-nodes/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE BTree(N INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, P INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT N, 'Leaf' AS Type FROM BTree ORDER BY N;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT N,
  CASE
    WHEN P IS NULL THEN 'Root'
    WHEN N IN (SELECT P FROM BTree WHERE P IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Inner'
    ELSE 'Leaf'
  END AS Type
FROM BTree
ORDER BY N;

content.description:
По каждому **`Founder`**: число **различных** имён компаний (**`Companies`**) и число **различных** **`Lead_Company_ID`** (**`Lead_Companies`**). Сортировка по `Founder`.

[HackerRank: New Companies](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/new-companies/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Companies(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT NOT NULL, Founder TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Lead_Company(Company_ID INTEGER NOT NULL, Lead_Company_ID INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT Founder AS Founder, COUNT(Name) AS Companies, COUNT(Lead_Company_ID) AS Lead_Companies FROM Companies JOIN Lead_Company ON Companies.ID = Lead_Company.Company_ID GROUP BY Founder ORDER BY Founder;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT C.Founder,
  COUNT(DISTINCT C.Name) AS Companies,
  COUNT(DISTINCT L.Lead_Company_ID) AS Lead_Companies
FROM Companies C
LEFT JOIN Lead_Company L ON L.Company_ID = C.ID
GROUP BY C.Founder
ORDER BY C.Founder;

steps.title: Агрегаты и STATION 2–20
steps.content:
## Aggregation

- `COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`; **`CAST(AVG(...) AS INTEGER)`** — округление вниз.
- `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, подзапросы с `MIN`/`MAX`.
- Станции 13–20: медиана через `OFFSET`, разница диапазонов, `BETWEEN`.

content.caption: GROUP BY сворачивает строки
content.description: Исключение min/max — фильтр NOT IN (min UNION max).
content.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 280 80" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Aggregation"><rect id="hr03-box" x="40" y="15" width="200" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e3f2fd" stroke="#1565c0"/><text x="140" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#0d47a1">Aggregation</text></svg>

content.description:
Сколько записей в таблице `CITY`? Одно число.

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - The Count Function](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-the-count-function/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NAME) FROM CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CITY;

content.description:
Сумма `POPULATION` всех городов с `COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`.

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - The Sum Function](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-the-sum-function/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'CHN';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN';

content.description:
Средняя `POPULATION` всех городов, **округлённая вниз** до целого (`CAST(AVG(...) AS INTEGER)`).

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - Averages](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-averages/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT ROUND(AVG(POPULATION)) FROM CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CAST(AVG(POPULATION) AS INTEGER) FROM CITY;

content.description:
Для каждой пары (`NAME` города как `CITY`, `DISTRICT`) средняя `POPULATION`, округлённая **вниз** до целого. Сортировка по `CITY`, затем `DISTRICT`.

[HackerRank: Average Population](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/average-population/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME, DISTRICT, AVG(POPULATION) FROM CITY GROUP BY NAME, DISTRICT ORDER BY NAME, DISTRICT;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT NAME AS CITY, DISTRICT, CAST(AVG(POPULATION) AS INTEGER) FROM CITY GROUP BY NAME, DISTRICT ORDER BY NAME, DISTRICT;

content.description:
Сумма населения по каждому `DISTRICT` для `COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`. Сортировка по `DISTRICT`.

[HackerRank: Japan Population](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/japan-population/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT DISTRICT, SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'CHN' GROUP BY DISTRICT ORDER BY DISTRICT;

content.description:
Для каждого студента с `MARKS > 0` верните **`Grade`**, **`NAME`**. Шкала: `MARKS >= 90 → 1`, `>= 80 → 2`, `>= 70 → 3`, `>= 60 → 4`, `>= 50 → 5`, `>= 40 → 6`, `>= 30 → 7`, `>= 20 → 8`, `>= 10 → 9`, `< 10 → 10`. Сортировка: `Grade` возр., `NAME` возр.

[HackerRank: The Report](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/the-report/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STUDENTS(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, MARKS INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MARKS, NAME FROM STUDENTS WHERE MARKS > 0 ORDER BY MARKS DESC, NAME;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN MARKS >= 90 THEN 1
    WHEN MARKS >= 80 THEN 2
    WHEN MARKS >= 70 THEN 3
    WHEN MARKS >= 60 THEN 4
    WHEN MARKS >= 50 THEN 5
    WHEN MARKS >= 40 THEN 6
    WHEN MARKS >= 30 THEN 7
    WHEN MARKS >= 20 THEN 8
    WHEN MARKS >= 10 THEN 9
    ELSE 10
  END AS Grade,
  NAME
FROM STUDENTS
WHERE MARKS > 0
ORDER BY Grade ASC, NAME ASC;

content.description:
Связь `Wands.id = Wands_Property.magic_wand_id`. Группировка по `(W.code, WP.age, идеальность: WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level)`. Для **идеальных** палочек — `MIN(W.coins_needed)`, для **неидеальных** — `MAX(W.coins_needed)`; колонки **`code`**, **`age`**, **`coins`**. Сортировка: `code`, `age`, `coins`.

[HackerRank: Ollivander's Inventory](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/ollivanders-inventory/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Wands(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code INTEGER NOT NULL, coins_needed INTEGER NOT NULL, power INTEGER NOT NULL, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Wands_Property(magic_wand_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, age INTEGER NOT NULL, is_rare INTEGER NOT NULL, min_safety_level INTEGER NOT NULL, max_safety_level INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT W.code, WP.age, MIN(W.coins_needed) FROM Wands W JOIN Wands_Property WP ON W.id = WP.magic_wand_id GROUP BY W.code, WP.age ORDER BY W.code, WP.age;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT W.code, WP.age,
  CASE WHEN WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level THEN MIN(W.coins_needed) ELSE MAX(W.coins_needed) END AS coins
FROM Wands W
JOIN Wands_Property WP ON W.id = WP.magic_wand_id
GROUP BY W.code, WP.age, WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level
ORDER BY W.code, WP.age, coins;

CREATE TABLE task_start(task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, start_day INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(task_id, start_day));
CREATE TABLE task_end(task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, end_day INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(task_id, end_day));

FROM task_start s

WHERE s.start_day = e.end_day
ORDER BY s.task_id, s.start_day;

По каждому `contest_id`: `contest_date`, `total_submissions`, **накопительная** сумма `total_submissions` (`running_total`). Сортировка по `contest_date`.

[HackerRank: 15 Days of Learning SQL](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/15-days-of-learning-sql/problem)
content.starterCode: SELECT C.contest_id, C.start_date, COUNT(S.submission_id) FROM Contests C JOIN Challenges CH ON C.contest_id = CH.contest_id JOIN Submissions S ON CH.challenge_id = S.challenge_id GROUP BY C.contest_id ORDER BY C.start_date;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT C.contest_id, C.start_date AS contest_date, COUNT(S.submission_id) AS total_submissions
  FROM Contests C
  JOIN Challenges CH ON C.contest_id = CH.contest_id
  JOIN Submissions S ON CH.challenge_id = S.challenge_id
  GROUP BY C.contest_id, C.start_date
)
SELECT contest_id, contest_date, total_submissions,
  SUM(total_submissions) OVER (ORDER BY contest_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
FROM daily
ORDER BY contest_date;

options: SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)

steps.title: Рекурсия и генерация строк
steps.content:
## Alternative Queries

- Параметр **`N`**: таблица **`params(n)`** в seed.
- **`WITH RECURSIVE`**: строки 1..N, проверка делителей для простых.
- Треугольники: `printf` для пробелов и повторов символов.

content.description:
Параметр `N` в `params`. **Равнобедренный** треугольник из `*` высотой `N` (строка `i`: `N-i` пробелов и `2*i-1` звёзд). **Важен порядок строк**.

[HackerRank: Draw The Triangle 1](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/draw-the-triangle-1/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE params(n INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT '*' FROM params;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE rows(i) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i + 1 FROM rows WHERE i < (SELECT n FROM params)
)
SELECT printf('%*s%s', (SELECT n FROM params) - i, '', printf('%.*s', 2 * i - 1, '********************************')) AS line
FROM rows;

content.description:
Параметр `N` в `params`. Строка `i` (1..N): число `i`, повторённое `i` раз подряд **без пробелов**.

[HackerRank: Draw The Triangle 2](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/draw-the-triangle-2/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE params(n INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT n FROM params;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE rows(i) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i + 1 FROM rows WHERE i < (SELECT n FROM params)
)
SELECT REPLACE(printf('%0*d', i, 0), '0', CAST(i AS TEXT)) AS line
FROM rows;
